id: \bTate and Liza spend a lot of time here. If they aren't in the gym they are usually here.
en: \bTate and Liza spend a lot of time here. If they aren't in the gym they are usually here.
it: \bTell e Pat passano molto tempo qui. Se non sono in palestra, di solito sono qui.

id: \bOh, you're here to challenge the Gym?
en: \bOh, you're here to challenge the Gym?
it: \bOh, sei qui per sfidare la Palestra?

id: \bThose two are my children. They won't be easy to beat.
en: \bThose two are my children. They won't be easy to beat.
it: \bQuei due sono i miei figli. Non sarà facile batterli.

id: \bYou ended up beating my kids? They do have a hard time getting along after all.
en: \bYou ended up beating my kids? They do have a hard time getting along after all.
it: \bAlla fine hai battuto i miei ragazzi? In effetti fanno fatica ad andare d'accordo.

id: \bSo you want to go to Sootopolis City. That place is hard to get into without the proper preperations.
en: \bSo you want to go to Sootopolis City. That place is hard to get into without the proper preperations.
it: \bQuindi vuoi andare a Ceneride. È un posto in cui è difficile entrare senza i giusti preparativi.

id: \bWe have a psychic in town who may be able to teleport you there. Why don't you go ask them?
en: \bWe have a psychic in town who may be able to teleport you there. Why don't you go ask them?
it: \bIn città c'è una persona con poteri psichici che potrebbe teletrasportarti lì. Perché non vai a chiederle?

id: \bHere at the institute we study how to get into space. We just launched a shuttle a few days ago.
en: \bHere at the institute we study how to get into space. We just launched a shuttle a few days ago.
it: \bQui all'istituto studiamo come arrivare nello spazio. Abbiamo lanciato una navetta proprio pochi giorni fa.

id: \bSophocles: Good, there you are. Ampharos here and I need to guide a space probe back to earth. But, um, Ampharos lost its confidence.
en: \bSophocles: Good, there you are. Ampharos here and I need to guide a space probe back to earth. But, um, Ampharos lost its confidence.
it: \bChrys: Bene, eccoti qui. Io e Ampharos dobbiamo guidare una sonda spaziale di ritorno sulla Terra. Ma, ehm, Ampharos ha perso la fiducia in sé.

id: \bI was thinking a battle might cheer it up. Seeing you battle always gave me a boost.
en: \bI was thinking a battle might cheer it up. Seeing you battle always gave me a boost.
it: \bPensavo che una lotta potesse tirargli su il morale. Vederti lottare mi ha sempre dato la carica.

id: \bSophocles: I think that did the trick. Thanks for your help.
en: \bSophocles: I think that did the trick. Thanks for your help.
it: \bChrys: Credo che abbia funzionato. Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New scheduled match for the World Coronation Series. The match will take place at Wyndon Stadium against Marnie.
en: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New scheduled match for the World Coronation Series. The match will take place at Wyndon Stadium against Marnie.
it: Rotom Phone: Annuncio. Nuovo incontro in programma per le World Coronation Series. L'incontro si terrà allo Stadio di Wyndon contro Mary.

id: \bI'm sorry that you can't go up any higher. Take this as a gift for coming though.
en: \bI'm sorry that you can't go up any higher. Take this as a gift for coming though.
it: \bMi spiace che tu non possa salire più in alto. Prendi questo come regalo per la visita, però.

id: \bWelcome to the Space Center. Feel free to look around.
en: \bWelcome to the Space Center. Feel free to look around.
it: \bBenvenuto al Centro Spaziale. Sentiti libero di dare un'occhiata.
